method: fire K concurrent identical requests to a single vLLM server, measure per-call latency and aggregate throughput; production GPU was under normal load (realistic condition)

gpt_oss_20b_worker_8006.finding: latency inflates 2.75x at K=16; throughput plateaus ~17.5/s beyond K=4 (admission-control queueing at the max-num-seqs cap)

gemma_4_31B_orchestrator_8000.finding: no self-contention up to K=16 (short) / K=8 (generation); vLLM continuous batching scales throughput near-linearly. The orchestrator lever is fewer sequential calls, not concurrency.
